annotations.title: Google Trends interest over time for one keyword (worldwide, 12 months)

description: Fetches Google Trends interest over the last 12 months, worldwide, for one search keyword: weekly relative interest (0-100, 100 = the peak) plus average, peak and latest values. Use it to see whether interest in a topic, product or brand is rising, falling or seasonal. Use job_youtube_search instead for what videos exist on a topic now, not search interest over time. Cost: $0.0015 per keyword result, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

keyword.description: One search term or phrase, as typed into Google (one line, up to 100 characters).

max_results.description: Most keyword results to return and pay for (default 1, at most 1); the run stops there.

name: job_google_trends

items.description: {keyword, status (ok; failed = refused by Google, free), hasData, summary {average, peak, peakDate, latest}, interestOverTime [{date, values, isPartial}]}

status.description: ok; failed = refused by Google, free

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)
